nodes.description: Internal owner address stored in BotProtected, set from tx.origin in the constructor and used for privileged checks.
Address of the external Ferrum Launch Protection bot-checker contract, invoked with low-level calls.
Public address of the Uniswap pair, computed in the constructor via pairOf and passed to the bot protection checker.
Public mapping of account balances, mutated directly without SafeMath in transferFrom/distribute/list.
Public nested mapping of allowances, written by approve/constructor and decremented in transferFrom.
Public total supply constant value of 240000000e18 used in list() share computation.
Immutable-ish address of the Uniswap V2 router used by list() to add liquidity.
Wrapped ETH address used as the pairing token when computing uniPair.
Modifier that performs an external low-level call to botProtection to verify sender/recipient are not bots.
Constructor that assigns owner from tx.origin, computes uniPair and pre-approves router and uniPair.
Payable transfer that simply delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Payable guarded transfer that mutates allowance and balances with unchecked arithmetic and an external bot-check call.
Payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without checks.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to address a with calldata b.
Pure helper computing the deterministic pair address from two tokens and hardcoded init code hash.
Owner-only function that calls botProtection and then overwrites balances of recipients in a loop.
Owner-only payable function adding Uniswap liquidity, calling botProtection and distributing balances.
Checked addition helper.
Checked subtraction helper.
Checked multiplication helper.
Checked division helper.
Caller address, attacker controllable, used for authorization checks and as from/spender in token operations.
Transaction origin used to set owner and as an allowance key, vulnerable to phishing-style attacks.
Block timestamp used as the Uniswap deadline in list(), miner influenceable.
Arbitrary delegatecall inside delegate() executed only with owner check; can destroy state via malicious target.
Low-level call to botProtection inside the checkBots modifier, external code executed on every protected transfer.
Low-level call to botProtection inside distribute() before state updates.
Low-level call to botProtection inside list() before the distribution loop.
External call to Uniswap router addLiquidityETH with msg.value forwarded and user-controlled amounts.
Unchecked subtraction of allowance and balances and unchecked addition of recipient balance in transferFrom.
Unchecked expression totalSupply * 6 / 100 and direct balance assignments in list().

edges.reason: checkBots modifier reads the botProtection state variable to build the external call.
Executing the checkBots modifier triggers the low-level call to botProtection.
The external botProtection call in checkBots happens before allowance/balance updates in transferFrom, allowing re-entrancy.
Constructor parameter _botProtection is stored into the botProtection state variable.
Constructor writes the botProtection state variable.
tx.origin is read in the constructor to initialize the owner address.
Owner is set from tx.origin, so origin-controlled accounts become the privileged owner.
Constructor calls pairOf(wETH, address(this)) to compute uniPair.
Result of pairOf is written into the uniPair state variable during construction.
Constructor writes unlimited allowances for the router and the pair address.
tx.origin is used as the allowance owner key in the constructor.
wETH address is used by the constructor when computing the pair.
transfer() delegates all logic to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transfer recipient parameter is forwarded into transferFrom.
transfer value parameter is forwarded into transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as _from in transferFrom and inside the allowance check.
_from parameter controls balance and allowance lookups in transferFrom.
_to parameter receives the credited balance in transferFrom.
_value parameter determines how much allowance and balance is subtracted.
transferFrom is guarded by the checkBots modifier, invoking its logic before the body.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping directly.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom performs unchecked subtraction and addition on balances/allowance.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
_spender parameter is the key granted allowance in approve.
_value parameter becomes the stored allowance amount.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing.
delegate reads the owner state variable for its authorization check.
Target address a is the delegatecall destination.
Calldata b is passed to the delegatecall.
delegate executes the arbitrary delegatecall operation.
tokenA determines the ordered token pair in pairOf.
tokenB determines the ordered token pair in pairOf.
pairOf computes and returns the local pair address.
distribute requires msg.sender == owner before running.
distribute reads owner for its authorization check.
_tos array supplies the recipients whose balances are overwritten.
amount is written into each recipient balance.
Loop index drives iteration over _tos in distribute.
distribute performs a low-level call to botProtection.
distribute overwrites entries of the balanceOf mapping.
The botProtection external call occurs before the balance distribution loop, allowing re-entrant calls.
list requires msg.sender == owner before running.
list reads owner for its authorization check.
_numList sets the contract balance and the liquidity token amount.
_tos array supplies distribution recipients in list.
_amounts array supplies distribution amounts in list.
Loop index drives iteration over the recipient arrays in list.
list invokes the Uniswap router addLiquidityETH external call.
routerForUniswap state variable is the target of the addLiquidityETH call.
block.timestamp + 600 is used as the Uniswap swap deadline.
list performs a low-level call to botProtection.
The botProtection external call in list precedes balance updates, enabling re-entrancy.
list computes totalSupply * 6 / 100 and assigns balances without SafeMath.
list overwrites entries of the balanceOf mapping.
